name: worked-example
note: LISTENING-STATS.md 5.13: device A, epoch E; stats.bin's MARK (A, E) 41; plays.1.jnl seqs 30-45, plays.jnl 46-48; ACKS (A, E) 45. 42 is X (Weather Vane) played 120 s of 200 s by Auto DJ at 2026-11-08T21:40Z (day 311, hour 7,485, time 26,948,401); 43 Y (Orbit Room) skipped at 12 s of 240 s; 44 Y stopped at 25 s of 40 s, a play (line 20 s); 45 durationMs 0, 8 s: neither; 46-48 three plays. The first boot plays on through its save (no compaction): it folds 42-48, MARK 48, and trims plays.1.jnl (under MARK and ACKS); plays.jnl stays (over ACKS). The second finds nothing above 48: no save, nothing trimmed.

name: rules
note: 4.1 on each kind of slot, no stats.bin before (a fresh start: every slot folded). plays.1.jnl: the line at an odd durationMs (20,000 of 40,001 ms is under it, 20,001 a play), durationMs 0 (30 s), a skip, completed and stopped under the line (neither), outcomes 0 and 4 (stopped), sources 0 and 4 (you), a skip over the line (a play), Auto DJ's skip, an undated play and one dated 2025 (undated), a drop note, then seq 12 damaged and again whole; its last slot a play, ACKS covering it: trimmed. plays.jnl: device B's play dated 2099 (dated), a slot with epoch 0 (not counted, never acknowledged) and device C's newer-major slot (not read): kept.

name: first-at-a
note: 5.2's merge is order-free: the same seven slots of two devices, read B's then A's (the scan reads plays.jnl first). Harbour Lights: B's dated play is earlier than A's (firstAt B's, source you); Tidewater: two undated plays, Auto DJ and shuffle (firstAt 0, the smaller source: shuffle); North Pier: a skip, then a play (firstAt the play's). first-at-a and first-at-b must give the same stats.bin.

name: first-at-b
note: 5.2's merge is order-free: the same seven slots of two devices, read A's then B's (the scan reads plays.jnl first). Harbour Lights: B's dated play is earlier than A's (firstAt B's, source you); Tidewater: two undated plays, Auto DJ and shuffle (firstAt 0, the smaller source: shuffle); North Pier: a skip, then a play (firstAt the play's). first-at-a and first-at-b must give the same stats.bin.

name: two-devices
note: Every player's plays on the card count (O2). stats.bin holds A's 1-3 (MARK (A) 3, no row for B); plays.1.jnl holds A 1-5 and B 1-3, plays.jnl A 6-8 and B 4-5; ACKS (A) 8, (B) 3. The boot folds A 4-8 and B 1-5: MARK (A) 8, (B) 5. plays.1.jnl is under ACKS and the saved MARK: trimmed; plays.jnl holds B 4-5 over ACKS: kept.

name: twice
note: Each slot once: plays.2.jnl (a later firmware's longer rotation) holds seqs 3-4 again, as plays.1.jnl does, and a seq 6 whose bytes differ from plays.jnl's (a conflict). The scan reads plays.jnl, plays.1.jnl, then plays.2.jnl: each key's first read is kept, and the three met again from another file count in HEAD's twice. No ACKS: nothing trimmed.

name: new-epoch
note: The device boots with a new epoch (NVS erased: its epoch is device[1]) and the root has no ACKS: 0.14.0's scan reads nothing then (PlayLog.cpp startScan); with stats the scan reads, and the old epoch's slots fold once under their own MARK row.

name: retention
note: 5.2's retention at a save, today day 452 (2027-03-29): two plays a day for 450 days (900 hours), one tomorrow by a fast clock, and device C's play dated 2099. HOUR keeps its newest 840 rows and DAYS its newest 400, 2099's and tomorrow's among them: rows by count, never by date. RCNT keeps the 32 days back from the earlier of today and the newest dated day (2099's): days 421-452, and tomorrow's and 2099's rows, newer than that. TRKD and HEAD keep everything.

name: rcnt-cap
note: 32 days (288-319) of the same 129 tracks (made-up paths outside the fixture library: orphans to the shelves, kept by the rankers) played once a day: 4,128 RCNT rows, over the 4,096 cap, so day 288 goes whole and 3,999 rows stay; the 30-day window then holds 30 days still.

name: no-clock
note: The clock never set: three undated plays, now unset at the save. sinceDay comes from the root's commitTime (flags bit 0); the shelves that need dates have no list, Most played's All time and Recently played (by lastOrd) do.

name: no-clock-dated
note: The board's clock unset, but device B's plays are dated, 100 days back: sinceDay is their earliest day (not flagged), and with no today nothing is pruned by date, so their RCNT rows stay.

name: compaction
note: A base of 6 rows (stats-00000001.bin) and a delta of 4 new rows from the log: over a quarter of the base, and nothing playing, so the boot's save compacts: stats-00000002.bin holds base (+) delta, stats.bin names it with an empty TRKD, and the old base goes. ACKS covers the log, which the new MARK covers too: trimmed.

name: compaction-playing
note: As compaction, with a track playing at the save: the delta (96 B) is under 96 KB, so no compaction; TRKD holds the 4 rows and the base stays.

name: gap
note: stats.bin's MARK (A) is 10; 0.14.0 then ran, the card was synced (ACKS (A) 50) and 0.14.0 trimmed the files holding 11-40 without folding them. The log now holds 41-60. The boot folds 41-60, counts seqs 11-40 in HEAD's gap (30: plays lost to the stats), and MARK covers them. The second boot finds nothing new: no save, no second count of the gap.

name: save-fails
note: stats.bin covers plays.1.jnl (MARK (A) 4); plays.jnl holds 5-8; ACKS (A) 8 covers both. The card is full: the boot's save fails, stats.bin stays as it was, and the trim follows the MARK read at the boot: plays.1.jnl goes, plays.jnl stays for the next boot to fold.

name: newer
note: stats.bin of a newer major (2; its frame whole). The stats are off this session: nothing folded, no save, and no trim although ACKS covers the log; every file is left as it is.

name: corrupt
note: stats.bin one byte short (FileBytes), and an older stats.bad. stats.bin is renamed stats.bad over the older one, and counting starts again from the log: every slot in it folded. The stale stats-00000001.bin it named is named by nothing now: nothing playing, the save compacts and writes the new base under that name, over it (5.3).

name: base-lost
note: The base stats.bin names (stats-00000001.bin) isn't there; a stats-00000002.bin (a cut compaction's) is. The base is lost: flags bit 1, baseGen 0, its rows gone, the totals kept; the fold goes on, and no stats-<n>.bin is removed on this boot. A track plays: no compaction.

name: base-other
note: Another file under the base's name: its header whole, its CRC not stats.bin's baseCrc. The base is lost (flags bit 1, the totals kept). Nothing playing, so the save compacts, and the new base, stats-00000001.bin again, replaces that file; nothing is removed.

name: base-unread
note: The base's header is the one stats.bin names, but its last row fails its CRC: a card fault, never a lost base. The stats are off this session (unread): nothing folded, no save, no trim; every file left as it is.

name: base-short
note: The base cut to 39 bytes: its header doesn't read whole, so the card failed it (unread), as at 41 bytes (Short) or any length (FileBytes): never a lost base.

name: base-neighbours
note: A stats-00000002.bin (a compaction cut before stats.bin named it) beside a stats.bin naming stats-00000001.bin, which checks whole: the neighbour is removed. A track plays: no compaction.

name: newer-minor
note: stats.bin of minor 3 (5.12): HEAD 32 bytes longer, every array's rows 8 bytes longer, and an OPTIONAL section XTRA. It reads (loaded) by its known sections and row prefixes; the save writes minor 0, without the additions. A track plays: no compaction.

name: clock-ahead
note: stats.bin holds 40 days of plays to day 312 (2026-11-09; RCNT its last 32 days). Boot 1: the board's clock a year ahead (day 677), and a play dated by it. RCNT keeps the 32 days back from 677: only that play's row. Boot 2: the clock corrected (day 313) and a new play (plays.jnl gains it before the boot): RCNT keeps 313's row and 677's (newer than the reference). HOUR, DAYS, TRKD and HEAD keep every row and count at both: the cost is RCNT's month, never a lifetime figure, an hour or a day. sinceDay stays day 273.

name: partial-open
note: stats.bin's MARK (A) 4; plays.1.jnl holds 1-8, plays.jnl 9-11; ACKS (A) 11. Boot 1: the card fails plays.1.jnl's open (unread, null: no slot read). The scan goes on: 9-11 folded, but the scan was partial, so no save; the trim keeps plays.1.jnl (unread) and follows the MARK read at the boot (4), so plays.jnl stays. Boot 2 reads both whole: 5-11 folded, each once; saved; both trimmed.

name: partial-read
note: As partial-open, but the card fails a read midway through plays.1.jnl: 6 slots read (1-6, so 5-6 folded), 7-8 not. 9-11 folded too; no save; nothing trimmed. Boot 2 folds 5-11 once.

name: partial-tail
note: stats.bin's MARK (A) 8; plays.1.jnl holds 3-8, plays.jnl 9-14; ACKS (A) 14. Boot 1: a read fault after plays.jnl's third slot (9-11 folded, 12-14 not): no save; the trim follows the MARK read at the boot, under which all of plays.1.jnl is: it goes (ACKS covers it), and plays.jnl (unread) stays. Boot 2 folds 9-14 once, saves, and trims plays.jnl.
